how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-arathi-highlands-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:693:obj:0: Find Trelane's Wand of Invocation and return it to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe.
rows.quest:693:details:0: Hey, ⟦1⟧. Sorry to be so short with ye earlier... and no, that ain't a pun.
rows.quest:693:details:1: BI figured out where Trelane's first item ended up: Kor'gresh has it in Boulderfist Hall. An' by the way he was throwing down blasts of ice at his kin to keep them in line, he must be close to figurin' out how to use all of its powers.
rows.quest:693:details:2: BBoulderfist Hall's south of here an' then east of Thandol Span. Find the ogre an' get back that wand.
rows.quest:693:details:3: BWhile you're gone, I'll figure out what we're gonna do about Stromgarde.
rows.quest:693:completion:0: Brilliant, ⟦2⟧. One item down an' three more to go, based on my list. The other three items are all in Stromgarde.
rows.quest:693:completion:1: BTake a rest an' get your strength back--the next phase of my plan'll require a little more time an' effort. Come back to me after you've gotten a warm meal an' some rest.
rows.quest:694:obj:0: Find an Azure Agate and bring it to Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe.
rows.quest:694:details:1: BHere's our next step: there're ogres all around the Tower of Arathor in Stromgarde. We're gonna need to activate the tower's defenses if you're gonna stand a chance against 'em an' still make it to the items alive. To do that, we're gonna need some gems the Boulderfist shaman have taken a liking to. They took 'em from the tower, but they're not gonna stay in their possession for long.
rows.quest:694:details:2: BGet one of them gems an' bring 'em to Kryten--he knows the spell to enchant 'em so they'll work as a key.
rows.quest:694:completion:0: You amaze me, ⟦3⟧. Well done again.
rows.quest:694:completion:1: BGive me a moment to cast the proper spell to enchant the gem, an' you'll be ready.
rows.quest:695:details:0: Here you are, ⟦4⟧. The gem only needs to be pressed against one of the pedestals near the base of the tower to activate its defenses. Use it when you're ready to enter the tower and find Trelane's remaining items.
rows.quest:695:details:1: BGood luck to you. I'll be awaiting your return here at the camp. Oh, and speak to Skuerto before you leave. He'll give you the rest of the details you'll need.
rows.quest:695:completion:1: BIf there are no other delays, how about we get started?
rows.quest:696:obj:0: Find Trelane's Phylactery, Trelane's Orb, and Trelane's Ember Agate, and return them to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe.
rows.quest:696:details:0: Here's what your lookin' for: Trelane's phylactery, Trelane's orb, an' Trelane's ember agate.
rows.quest:696:details:1: BAll three should be in chests within the tower an' you shouldn't have a problem opening the chests on your own; you just have to be careful of the ogres.
rows.quest:696:details:2: BThe tower's defenses won't take care of 'em on their own; you'll need to have your weapons at the ready. Those ogres find out you're there and stealing from 'em, an' they'll be sure to put the hurt on you.
rows.quest:696:completion:0: Malin couldn't've asked a worthier person to come here an' aid us, ⟦5⟧. You've done a grand job!
rows.quest:696:completion:1: BHe'll be pleased to see what an overwhelming success our mission's been.
rows.quest:697:obj:0: Take the Sealed Letter to Archmage Malin in the Mage Quarter of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:697:details:0: Take this letter back to ⟦E1⟧ and let Malin know that Kryten an' I'll be home soon. He'll reward you well for helping us here, ⟦6⟧, of that I've no doubt.
rows.quest:697:completion:0: <Archmage Malin opens the letter, and his eyes grow wide.>
rows.quest:697:completion:1: BBy the Light, you've done it. How wonderful. Trelane will be so pleased. I'm sure Kryten and Skuerto are just as excited as I am to have them on their way back to ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:697:completion:2: BThank you, ⟦7⟧. Please, take this to help you in your journeys.
rows.quest:701:obj:0: Acquire 12 ⟦E2⟧ Hearts from Highland Fleshstalkers for ⟦E3⟧'gan.
rows.quest:701:details:0: With some additional objects, I will be able to create an item that will imbue Gor'mul with the guile of the raptor! With the power of the raptor flowing through him, Gor'mul will know our new power and rediscover the warrior that lies dormant!
rows.quest:701:details:1: BI will require raptor hearts to fashion the item and spell.
rows.quest:701:completion:0: Yes, these will work perfectly. I will transfer their power and the spirit of the raptors into this orb. This orb will imbue Gor'mul with the fiery strength and intelligence of the raptor.
rows.quest:702:details:0: Take this orb and use its energy to give Gor'mul the essence of the raptor. Surely this will invigorate his spirit and give him new purpose in life. With him returned to normal, we can explain to him the current state of the ⟦E4⟧, and we will have a great warrior's assistance in our unceasing battles.
rows.quest:702:completion:0: At least it is something interesting you bring to me this time. A strange power it emits...
rows.quest:847:details:0: This... this power.... Is this the power of the shamans that ⟦E3⟧'gan tried to show me? I must say, it is interesting. Tell ⟦E3⟧'gan that he has convinced me... for the time being. I will listen to what he has to say.
rows.quest:847:completion:0: When the enchantment wears off, I will speak with Gor'mul. My thanks to you for your help in returning Gor'mul to the land of the living. I have no doubt he thanks you greatly as well.
